findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: Observed buildup of dried milk on floor of display cooler. Clean up dried milk.  (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.comment:
Observed the hot water at the left hand sink in women’s restroom to be cool and without adequate pressure.
5-103.12: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, EQUIPMENT, and nonFOOD EQUIPMENT that are required to use water except that water (A) and (B) to a TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT or in response to a temporary interruption of a water supply need not be under pressure.    
Store care will have the fixture functioning properly within one week.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Areas under card stock has evidence of rodent droppings. Clean and maintain clean so that the pest control company has a more valid way to help them evaluate the presence or absence of rodents.  Clean and maintain free of rodent droppings. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: Observed that the cold water faucet does not provide water under pressure to the extent that it tempers the hot water coming from the faucet. Provide proper mixing valve or repair cold water faucet. 750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: One toilet seat in the women's rest room is does not have a sanitary split. Replace the toilet seat with a proper sanitary seat. 750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
